description: Classifies build input as a URL, local file path, or raw HTML string and returns the resolved content ready for building. Use FIRST when the user gives you a link, a file path, or ambiguous input instead of raw HTML — it tells you what you actually received. Params: input (string, required). Workflow position: before mimic_discover_ds, at the very start of a build.

input.description: A URL, file path, or raw HTML string to classify and resolve.

name: mimic_pipeline_resolve
